text:
Plan 24 Kestrel modules: indexer, media, webhooks, alerts, feed, checkout, returns, upload, auth, session, export, pricing, profile, cache, shipping, reports, search, gateway, audit, metrics, catalog, ledger, ingest, sync.

Fixed: catalog retry 8, batch 200; checkout timeout 75; webhooks timeout 50; upload timeout 85; cache ttl 360; audit batch 250; session queue 50.

Must hold: feed ttl≥540; sync timeout≥120; audit ttl≤90; gateway timeout≥120; metrics timeout≤15; alerts retry≤2; shipping queue≥500; reports batch≤150.

Workers: feed, webhooks on delta; checkout, returns, catalog, export, metrics on alpha; ledger on beta. Shared: pricing+session, alerts+auth, cache+profile. Split: audit/shipping, audit/returns, catalog/ingest, alerts/ledger.

Deps: ledger→checkout,profile; indexer→media,search,alerts; session→pricing; export→profile; metrics→pricing. Order: checkout<returns; cache<audit; metrics<indexer; gateway<auth. Forbidden (transitive): auth→catalog, gateway→webhooks, ingest→pricing, metrics→catalog.

Open (don't guess): file-ownership rules; the eight unset settings; workers for indexer, media, upload, shipping, reports, search, gateway, audit, ingest, sync.
